hostProject.description: Existing .rvt opened as the host document. The queue does not open an .rte template.

confirmWrite.description: Must be true before any job may set its dry-run input to true.

jobs.description: Execution order. This array order is kept; it is not sorted back into tools.json order.

inputs.description: Keys must match the tool's inputs in tools.json. Omitted keys use the declared default. A missing run value becomes false.
